description: Dotflowy is an open-source outlining and note-taking app positioned as a Workflowy alternative, with real-time sync, import/export, and AI-agent access to outlines. Its public site and repository docs describe an MCP interface for agents to read and modify a user's outline.
summary: dotflowy.com publicly documents one developer integration surface: an OAuth-protected MCP server at `https://<your-deployment>/mcp`; no public HTTP/REST, GraphQL, or CLI surface was found for the dotflowy.com domain.
